decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the firm's core pipeline-fitting business and uses the existing welding and coating capabilities, so dropping it saves little, and the firm's announced expansion of its range supports keeping it despite its modest visibility on the website.

Having given the ceiling or floor pipe bracket its own page, the firm has publicly committed to it as part of its announced range expansion, and any weak early sales can still be put down to the normal ramp-up time of infrastructure projects.
The pipe support bracket builds on established fabrication capabilities and is presented on its own page, so its sunk investment and visible commitment make keeping it the expected course.
